contract.pip: NOT a supported installation mechanism. requirements-lock.txt lists the same version numbers for reference only. Tested 2026-10-07 on macOS 27.0 arm64: `pip install scipy==1.15.3` installs the wheel scipy-1.15.3-cp313-cp313-macosx_14_0_arm64, whose Mach-O libraries (first failure: scipy/sparse/linalg/_propack/_spropack) carry a zero-fill section __DATA,__thread_bss with a non-zero file offset; the macOS 27 loader refuses them, so `import scipy.stats` fails. The conda build of the same scipy version has offset 0 and loads. pip on other platforms: untested.
